name: key_missing
violation_expr: pickup_datetime_local IS NULL OR dropoff_datetime_local IS NULL OR pu_location_id IS NULL OR do_location_id IS NULL

name: zone_not_in_lookup
violation_expr: pu_borough IS NULL OR do_borough IS NULL
description: pickup or drop-off LocationID not in the TLC taxi zone lookup

name: ts_pickup_outside_file_month
description: pickup not in the month of the file it was published in

name: ts_zero_duration
description: pickup and drop-off at the same second

name: type_non_integer_code
description: passenger_count or RatecodeID is not a whole number before the int cast

name: range_vendor_unknown
violation_expr: vendor_id IS NULL OR NOT vendor_id IN (1, 2, 6, 7)
description: VendorID not in the data dictionary

name: range_ratecode_unknown
violation_expr: ratecode_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT ratecode_id IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 99)
description: RatecodeID not in the data dictionary

name: range_payment_type_unknown
violation_expr: payment_type IS NULL OR NOT payment_type IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
description: payment_type not in the data dictionary

name: range_store_fwd_unknown
violation_expr: store_and_fwd_flag IS NOT NULL AND NOT store_and_fwd_flag IN ('Y', 'N')

name: missing_fields_flex_fare
violation_expr: payment_type = 0 AND (passenger_count IS NULL OR ratecode_id IS NULL OR store_and_fwd_flag IS NULL OR congestion_surcharge_usd IS NULL OR airport_fee_usd IS NULL)
description: Flex Fare trip (payment_type 0) without passenger count / rate code / surcharges

name: missing_fields_non_flex
violation_expr: payment_type <> 0 AND (passenger_count IS NULL OR ratecode_id IS NULL OR store_and_fwd_flag IS NULL OR congestion_surcharge_usd IS NULL OR airport_fee_usd IS NULL)
description: passenger count / rate code / surcharges missing on a non-Flex-Fare trip

name: unique_trip_duplicate
description: several rows share the duplicate key (all copies quarantined)
